title: Arita-yaki Porcelain Rice Bowl Set 5pcs
description_en: Handcrafted in Arita, the birthplace of Japanese porcelain since 1616. Each bowl features a delicate blue underglaze design fired at 1300°C. Microwave and dishwasher safe. A UNESCO-recognized art form.
description_ja: 1616年から続く有田焼の名窯で職人が手がけた茶碗5枚セット。繊細な染付文様が1300℃の高温で焼き付けられた逸品。電子レンジ・食洗機対応。
